cases.name: cm measurement, smoker
cases.findings: 1.2 cm solid nodule in the left lower lobe. No other pulmonary nodules.

cases.name: edge: 6 mm sits in the 6-8 mm band
cases.findings: Solitary 6 mm solid nodule in the right middle lobe. The lungs are otherwise clear.
cases.history: Never smoker, no family history of lung cancer. Low risk.

cases.name: negated feature: no solid component
cases.findings: 8 mm pure ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe with no solid component. No other nodules.

cases.name: multiple subsolid, largest in cm (pack has no not-assessable state)
cases.findings: Two ground-glass nodules: 1.5 cm in the right upper lobe and 6 mm in the left lower lobe. Neither has a solid component.

cases.name: unstated: risk
cases.findings: 7 mm solid nodule in the left upper lobe. No further pulmonary nodules.

cases.name: distractor: adrenal adenoma size
cases.findings: Single 4 mm solid nodule in the right lower lobe. Incidental 3 cm left adrenal adenoma.

cases.name: history settles risk: heavy smoker, family history
cases.findings: Two solid pulmonary nodules, the larger 5 mm in the right upper lobe and the other 3 mm in the left lower lobe.
cases.history: Current smoker, 50 pack-years. Father had lung cancer. High risk.

cases.name: abbreviation heavy: RUL PSN
cases.findings: RUL 7mm PSN, solid component 3mm. No other nods.

cases.name: dictated differently: subsolid with a solid focus, mean diameter
cases.findings: Subsolid nodule in the lingula measuring 9 x 7 mm (mean 8 mm), predominantly ground-glass with a small solid focus. No other nodule seen.

cases.name: dictated differently: scattered tiny nodules, largest 4 mm
cases.findings: Several scattered tiny solid pulmonary nodules, the largest 4 mm in the right middle lobe.

cases.name: cm measurement, simple cyst
cases.findings: Renal mass protocol CT. 3.4 cm well-defined cyst in the interpolar left kidney with a thin smooth wall, no septa, no calcification and no solid component. Uniform fluid contents measuring 8 HU on the unenhanced series, with no enhancement after contrast.
cases.history: Indeterminate left renal lesion on ultrasound.

cases.name: edge: 20 HU is in the -9 to 20 band
cases.findings: Renal mass protocol CT. 2.6 cm well-defined right lower pole cyst with a thin wall, no septa, calcification or nodularity. Homogeneous contents measuring 20 HU unenhanced, no enhancement on the nephrographic phase.

cases.name: negated feature: no nodularity, single thin septum
cases.findings: Renal mass protocol CT. 4 cm well-defined cyst in the right lower pole with a single thin (1 mm) septum and a fleck of calcification. No nodularity or wall thickening. Uniform contents of 12 HU, non-enhancing.

cases.name: not assessable: protrusion enhancement on portal venous only
cases.findings: Portal venous phase CT only. 3 cm well-defined left renal cyst with a 2 mm soft tissue protrusion from the wall; whether it enhances cannot be assessed without an unenhanced series.

cases.name: unstated: calcification
cases.findings: Renal mass protocol CT. 2.8 cm well-defined left renal cyst with a thin wall, no septa and no nodularity. Uniform contents of 10 HU unenhanced with no enhancement.

cases.name: distractor: simple contralateral cyst
cases.findings: Renal mass protocol CT. 5 cm well-defined right upper pole cystic mass with a thick (5 mm) enhancing septum and no nodules. Separate 1 cm simple cyst in the left kidney with no septa.

cases.name: history settles technique: unenhanced CT KUB
cases.findings: 1.8 cm well-defined homogeneous left renal lesion with a thin wall, no septa, calcification or nodularity, measuring 75 HU.
cases.history: Unenhanced CT KUB for suspected renal colic.

cases.name: abbreviation heavy: many thin enhancing septa
cases.findings: CT RMP: L kidney 2.5cm cyst, well-def, thin wall, 4+ thin enh septa, no nod/calc. Contents homog 15HU on NCCT, no enh.

cases.name: dictated differently: complex cystic lesion with mural nodule
cases.findings: Complex cystic lesion arising from the right kidney measuring 4.5 cm on renal mass protocol CT, with an enhancing 6 mm mural nodule forming acute margins with the wall.

cases.name: dictated differently: hyperdense non-enhancing cyst
cases.findings: Renal mass protocol. 4 cm right renal lesion, homogeneous, 45 HU unenhanced and 46 HU on the nephrographic phase, so not enhancing. Well-defined with an imperceptible wall, no septa, calcification or nodularity.

cases.name: cm measurement, full Brock history
cases.findings: 1.4 cm spiculated solid nodule in the right upper lobe. No calcification or fat. Background centrilobular emphysema. No other pulmonary nodules. No previous imaging for comparison.
cases.history: 68-year-old woman, current smoker. No family history of lung cancer.

cases.name: edge: 5 mm is in the 5 to under 6 mm band
cases.findings: 5 mm solid nodule in the left lower lobe with no calcification. This is the first CT; no prior imaging.

cases.name: negated features: no emphysema, smooth margin, 8 mm edge
cases.findings: 8 mm smooth solid nodule in the right middle lobe. No calcification or fat. No emphysema. Solitary nodule. No prior CT.
cases.history: 55-year-old man, ex-smoker. No family history of lung cancer.

cases.name: interval in months is not a verbatim day count (pack has no not-assessable state)
cases.findings: 9 mm solid nodule in the right lower lobe, no calcification. Volumetry 210 mm3, previously 120 mm3 on the baseline CT 12 months ago.

cases.name: unstated: age
cases.findings: 11 mm solid nodule in the left upper lobe with a smooth margin and no calcification. No emphysema. No other nodules. No prior imaging.
cases.history: Male, never smoker, no family history of lung cancer.

cases.name: distractor: calcified granuloma elsewhere
cases.findings: 6 mm solid nodule in the right lower lobe with no calcification. Separately, a 12 mm densely calcified granuloma in the left upper lobe. No previous imaging.

cases.name: history settles family history, age and sex
cases.findings: Solitary 10 mm solid nodule in the right upper lobe with a lobulated margin, no calcification or fat. Mild paraseptal emphysema. No previous imaging available.
cases.history: 72-year-old female, ex-smoker. Mother had lung cancer.

cases.name: abbreviation heavy: RML 4mm SN
cases.findings: RML 4mm SN, no calc. No prev CT.

cases.name: dictated differently: intrapulmonary lymph node on the fissure
cases.findings: 6 mm smooth triangular nodule abutting the right horizontal fissure, typical of an intrapulmonary lymph node.

cases.name: dictated differently: pure ground-glass opacity
cases.findings: 15 mm pure ground-glass opacity in the LUL with no solid component and no calcification.
